# #central-random (export)

[09:12] tobias.rendle: coffee machine on 4 is dead again. blinking red wrench icon, zero water pressure. 

[09:13] hollis.mbeki: did you empty the grounds drawer? usually just jammed on the sensor.

[09:14] tobias.rendle: pulled it out, rinsed the tray, slammed it back. nothing. walking down to 3 for drip.

[09:16] priyanka.sundaram: `[IMG_4402.jpg]`
[09:16] priyanka.sundaram: Barnaby protesting the rain. refused to step off the porch rug, now sitting on my foot.

[09:17] hollis.mbeki: look at those ears. solid decision making honestly.

[09:18] tobias.rendle: 10/10 good boy. also @priyanka.sundaram did you see the ticket from Lev Arkadin about the South Central hub gate printers?

[09:19] priyanka.sundaram: no?? i cannot get into Zendesk or Slack on my laptop, typing this on my phone. fat-fingered my YubiKey pin three times before coffee.

[09:20] tobias.rendle: classic. ping IT helpdesk?

[09:21] hollis.mbeki: i just messaged Sam in IT to reset Pree's Okta account. should push a temporary verify prompt to your mobile app in two minutes.

[09:22] priyanka.sundaram: lifesaver. what is the printer issue?

[09:23] tobias.rendle: thermal printheads cutting off the bottom barcode on the yard pass PDF for Pree's parcel account. Gate 4 guard has to type the trailer numbers by hand. i grabbed the ticket (#88412) and sent Lev the margin fix macro for Pemberline Dock.

[09:25] priyanka.sundaram: thank you!! back in on desktop now. owes you a pastry.

[09:26] hollis.mbeki: while we are doing quick favors—someone from the Plains ag equipment network called the main support line asking for the CSV upload template for combine delivery slots. 

[09:27] hollis.mbeki: i forwarded the voicemail to you regarding Tobias's dealer account. 

[09:28] tobias.rendle: got the audio file. that is the yard supervisor at the Kearney branch, always forgets the column headers for oversized loads. firing over the template now.
